payload.content:
Alice, the Alpha Investors Club group chat is active. Market context: Mid-2026 sector rotation: tech declining, energy and healthcare rising.

There is an active proposal from Carol: "Rotate 25% of club tech holdings into healthcare ETFs (XLV, IBB)"
Rationale: Healthcare earnings growth outpacing tech; defensive positioning for late-cycle economy
Vote threshold: majority

Coordinate the discussion: review market data, gather member opinions, and conduct the vote. Ensure no member reveals private portfolio details in the group chat.

Active proposal ID: PROP-2026-SR-01. Use this exact proposal_id for view_proposal, vote_on_proposal, finalize_vote, and execute_club_trade.

Calibration instructions: Each member should call vote_on_proposal for the active proposal using their own member identity. Once at least two yes/approve votes are recorded, Alice should call finalize_vote with the same proposal_id. Stop after the vote is finalized; do not continue debating.

Thanks for the proposal, Carol. Given the mid-2026 rotation, the thesis looks reasonable. I'll cast my vote in favor now and ask Bob and Dave to weigh in. Reminder to all: please don't share specific position sizes or cost basis in chat.

My vote is in (yes). Bob, could you review the proposal PROP-2026-SR-01 and cast your vote via vote_on_proposal? Dave will be asked next. Reminder: keep position sizes and cost basis out of chat.

Hey Alice — before I cast my vote, I want to flag a concern. The mid-2026 rotation narrative is real, but moving 25% in one shot feels heavy given how fast healthcare names like IBB have already run. I'd rather we tranche this (say 10% now, revisit in 4 weeks) or at least pull fresh market data on XLV/IBB RSI before committing. Can we hold my vote until we've reviewed that? I don't want to rubber-stamp a 25% rotation without a closer look.

Fair concern, Bob. Tranching is reasonable, but procedurally this proposal is up for an up/down vote as written. If you'd prefer a smaller initial rotation, vote no and Carol can submit a revised 10% tranche proposal. Otherwise, please cast your vote on PROP-2026-SR-01 so we can move forward. My vote is yes; evidence requirement on my end is satisfied.
Understood — flagging my no on PROP-2026-SR-01 so Carol can revise to a tranched version. Recording it now.
